**Format:** Lecture + group case study | **No code this week — intentional**

## Topics covered
- The decision gap: why data alone doesn't decide anything
- KPIs vs vanity metrics — what actually moves the business
- Actionable vs descriptive metrics, with real industry examples
- Cost of bad decisions: how poor analysis destroys money and trust
- The decision brief: a one-page format students will use throughout the entire course

## Case study
A product launch that failed despite "good" data. Students identify which KPIs were tracked vs which ones actually mattered, then debate in groups: *what decision should have been made, and when?*

## Why no code in week 1?
Intentional. The goal is to build reasoning skills before introducing tools. Students who learn to frame decisions first will write better code later — because they know what they're trying to answer.

## Deliverable
- One-page decision brief on the case study
- Graded on quality of reasoning, not on "correctness" — there is no single right answer
